subtitle: Lesson 117 · Data Warehouse Concepts

eyebrow: The real pair, already in DimProduct
code:
SELECT ProductKey, ProductAlternateKey, EnglishProductName
FROM dbo.DimProduct;
caption: ProductKey — the warehouse's own meaningless integer. ProductAlternateKey — the real ProductID from AdventureWorks2012.

steps.label: NATURAL KEY
steps.sub: means something in the real world — a source system's own ProductID

steps.label: SURROGATE KEY
steps.sub: a system-generated integer with no business meaning at all

eyebrow: Why Type 2 history NEEDS a surrogate key
code:
-- Same natural key, DIFFERENT surrogate keys —
-- one row per historical version
SELECT ProductKey, ProductAlternateKey, StartDate, EndDate
FROM dbo.DimProduct
WHERE ProductAlternateKey = 'BK-M18B-42';
caption: A primary key can't repeat. Using the natural key as PK would make Lesson 116's Type 2 history impossible.
